raw_text: Was Mumbai's October 2020 blackout a Chinese cyber attack? The Recorded Future report on RedEcho has reignited questions about the massive power outage that crippled Mumbai on October 12, 2020 — exactly during the LAC standoff. The blackout affected local trains, hospitals, and the stock exchange. While the official inquiry blamed a state grid failure, security researchers now point to the RedEcho intrusions at load despatch centres as a possible contributing factor. Maharashtra Cyber Cell had identified suspicious Chinese IP addresses accessing the state electricity board's systems. The timing and targeting make a compelling circumstantial case.
